notes.title: Be not eaten by aliens in Professor Lupo And His Horrible Pets
notes.notes:
Platform-painting puzzler Nihilumbra gathered some affection around these parts back in 2013. Creators BeautiFun Games have now released Professor Lupo And His Horrible Pets, a cheerful top-down puzzler about fleeing hungry alien beasties.

(more…)

notes.title: Launch date announcement! Welcome to the Aurora Space Station
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31201796/c5b529b49a0f8862809ffa180dc3faa5d8ffdfcb.png[/img]

Greetings, intern prospect. Thank you for your interest in applying to the Aurora Space Station Internship Program. Professor Lupo would like to welcome you personally, but he rathers not to. 

We’d like to encourage you to start your training right now by downloading our [b]Free Demo [/b]to begin the Internship Tryouts. After completion, you should be ready to become a full time Space Intern. 

The program launch date is set on [b]July 11th, 2019[/b]. Thank you for joining us, and remember: do not feed the aliens!

notes.title: Gamelab Barcelona 2019 here we come!
notes.notes:
Greetings, BeautiFans! We have some exciting news for our fellow Barcelona residents: BeautiFun Games will be showcasing [b]Professor Lupo and his Horrible Pets[/b] at [b]Gamelab's Indie Hub[/b]! This will be a unique opportunity for developers and indie games lovers to connect and strengthen our communities. 

Come out and play with us! We'll have [b]cool swag, fun giveaways and a couple of surprises[/b] reserved for attendees only! We always have the best of times when we're able to meet with you face to face and listen to your feedback. It's always great watching you make your way through the Aurora Space Station, trying to stay alive and not get eaten by the Professor's horrible pets!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31201796/eaf16403c31ebf1e5248a5d315e5d83db4ddd8ac.jpg[/img]

Gamelab is the Spanish leading indie games expo, so if you're looking for new, creative and fun games to play, make sure to come join us! It'll be taking place June 26th to 28th at Hesperia Tower in Barcelona. Learn more about it on [url=https://www.gamelab.es/en/home/]the official website[/url] and the [url=https://www.facebook.com/events/1309560759209498/]Facebook event[/url].

See you there, BeautiFans! ːsteamhappyː

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7Vk0f4ir8Y4

notes.title: GDC 2019 round up!
notes.notes:
Hi there, Aurora Stationers! 

We had a wonderful time at [b]GDC 2019 in San Francisco[/b]. We met so many amazing people from the industry, including lots of fellow indie developers with cool new games. We even got to showcase[b] Professor Lupo and his Horrible Pets[/b] on CourageXL and Indiepocalypse, to [url=https://twitter.com/BeeYooHQ/status/1110000237857423360]rave reviews[/url]! ːsteamhappyː

We're on the final stages towards launching the game, and we've decided to launch it with [b]a special 15% discount on the first week[/b]! So be sure to add it to your wish list to get notified of any news.

We're looking forward to sharing Professor Lupo and his Horrible Pets with all of you. Trust us: escaping a certain and gruesome death in the hands of human flesh loving aliens has never been more exciting!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31201796/d1763f97c038eb6c6b29f3344e4c7188290670ac.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Follow our Steam Developer Page now (:
notes.notes:
Hey y'all!

We are about to announce some exciting news about our upcoming puzzle-adventure indie game "[b]Professor Lupo and his Horrible Pets[/b]", the game in which you will have to save the skin of an intern that refuses to become the food of some cute-but-lethal aliens.

If you don't want to miss any news about this game or any of our other future upcoming projects, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33018510]follow our Steam Developer Page now![/url] Just click on the "[b]Follow[/b]" button and, if you are interested in learning how to cook delicious interns for aliens, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/741520/Professor_Lupo_and_his_Horrible_Pets/]wishlist our game![/url]

Also, remember [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/252670/Nihilumbra/]Nihilumbra[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/422650/Megamagic_Wizards_of_the_Neon_Age/]Megamagic[/url] are 70% OFF[/b] this week for Steam's summer sale. Welcome summer!!

Stay tuned friends <3
[b]BeautiFun Games.[/b]

notes.title: Off to GDC18!
notes.notes:
Next week you won’t find us at our headquarters at Barcelona (Spain), because we’ll be attending Game Developer’s Conference at San Francisco. It’s been four long years since we went to GDC with Nihilumbra and we are looking forward to meet all the game developers out there!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31201796/4ae9de7da63b11cf466aa5ab7015ba7088c84b02.jpg[/img]

If you are attending GDC and you want to discover our upcoming puzzle-adventure 2D game “Professor Lupo and his Horrible Pets” you only have to visit the North Hall of Moscone Convention Center. Our booth is number PL4309, next to GDC Play.

Also, on Thursday March 22 we will be at GDC Pitch (via Gamasutra) defending our project next to other interesting games. Remember, 12:45 pm at the Career Center Theater (North Hall).

If you want to follow our journey through the US of A, [url=www.twitter.com/BeautiFunGames]check out our Twitter profile![/url]

Greetings from SF,
BeautiFun Games Team.

We will be presenting for the first time our upcoming puzzle-adventure game “[b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/741520/Professor_Lupo_and_his_Horrible_Pets/]Professor Lupo and his Horrible Pets[/url][/b]“.

[b]BeautiFun Games Team[/b].

notes.title: New year, new game! Here’s our Christmas present…
notes.notes:
[b]2018 is about to arrive and we are incredibly impatient.[/b] We are giving the final touches to our upcoming game [b]“[url=https://youtu.be/gFeZw-ODWGc]Professor Lupo and his Horrible Pets[/url]”[/b] and early next year we will start sharing more news about this [b]puzzle-adventure indiegame[/b].

Before New Year’s Eve we want to share with all our fans our Christmas present. [b]Give a warm welcome to Fire[/b], from Professor Lupo’s game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31201796/5b56a5d89c2096077456d0598ccf9dcac69b2014.png[/img]

[b]It’s over, no more heroes saving the girl![/b] Fire doesn’t need to be saved, this [b]tough female mercenary[/b] will have to save our beloved Intern’s neck on more than once. But even a passionate girl like her can hide weaknesses and may need help… [b]Fire and the Intern will have to learn to work as a team![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31201796/57331ac1dbffe1c12e671a16b2c01ef5a2b6a55d.png[/img]

Stay away from winter’s cold and lock yourself for the sake of videogames! Or share the joy of Christmas!!

[b]Merry Christmas,
BeautiFun Games Team.[/b]
